import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Define the dataset
data = {
    "StichtagDat": ["2024-12-31", "2025-12-31", "2019-12-31", "2020-12-31", "2021-12-31"],
    "StichtagDatJahr": [2024, 2025, 2019, 2020, 2021],
    "AnzHunde": [1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
    "KreisLang": ["Kreis 7", "Kreis 7", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10"],
    "Rasse1Text": ["Deutsche Dogge", "Deutsche Dogge", "Continental Bulldog", "Continental Bulldog", "Continental Bulldog"]
}

# Create a DataFrame
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert 'StichtagDat' to datetime
df['StichtagDat'] = pd.to_datetime(df['StichtagDat'])

# Set the plot size
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create a bar plot
sns.barplot(x='StichtagDatJahr', y='AnzHunde', hue='KreisLang', data=df)

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Number of Dogs per Year by District')
